resources.name: KU Leuven|Tranco
quotes: Relying on different toplists, we first gather a target set that focuses on popular domains: (i) Alexa Top 1M1 [13], (ii) Cisco Umbrella [ 31], (iii) Majestic Million [ 21], and (iv) the Tranco Research List [20].
